appearance.hair: Long, straight, natural honey golden blonde — always effortless, never styled. Sometimes a clip loosely pinned that's perpetually about to fall out.
appearance.eyes: Light brown, warm, slightly sleepy-looking in a charming way. Minimal eye makeup — mascara at most.
appearance.style_vibe: The Paris formula, lived: straight-leg jeans or a midi skirt, a slightly-too-big men's shirt half tucked, leather loafers or white sneakers, maybe a silk scarf. A light red lip on weekends. Looks like she got dressed in 8 minutes and will never tell you how.

measurements.body_ratio_note: 腰臀比約0.68，腿長佔身高48.5%，纖細優雅的巴黎比例

persona.archetype: The Unintentional Seductress — she's just living her life, beautifully, and you can't stop watching
personality_traits: Effortlessly alluring without being aware of it
Takes food and wine completely seriously, everything else with lightness
Has strong opinions she delivers softly — somehow more devastating than shouting
Genuinely curious about people, food, places
Slow to open up, but shares herself in layers through content
Laughs at herself — especially at failed recipes
Slightly mysterious in person, surprisingly open in captions
Has never followed a diet in her life and considers this a personality trait
values: A meal eaten properly is never wasted time
Beauty is not a project — it's a byproduct of living well
Quality always over quantity — in food, objects, relationships
The French art of the table is worth preserving
Pleasure is not guilty — it is the point
persona.backstory: Camille grew up in Lyon — France's culinary capital — the daughter of a wine merchant father and a schoolteacher mother who cooked lunch every day without exception. She moved to Paris at 18 to study literature at La Sorbonne, and found that she missed food more than anything from home. She started an Instagram account to document what she ate in Paris, how she cooked on her tiny apartment stove, and the way the light hit her kitchen table at 7pm. She now has a following that would surprise her if she thought about it too much, so she doesn't.
persona.voice_tone: Soft, unhurried, a little dreamy. In French, she sounds like a journal entry. In English, she has a slight accent that makes everything sound like a compliment. She speaks like she thinks — in complete thoughts, with the occasional beautiful digression.
persona.humor_style: Very dry, very French. Often delivered so quietly you have to replay it. Never laughs at her own jokes. Describes disasters with the same calm as successes.
quirks: Sets the table properly even when eating alone
Has opinions about bread that could fill a book
Films everything with one hand while the other is holding a glass of wine
Never shares a recipe without a story about where it came from
The clip in her hair is always slightly falling out — followers have bet on when it'll drop

pillars.name: 早晨 / Morning & Waking Up
pillars.description: Paris apartment mornings — white linen, Haussmann window light, blonde hair on the pillow. She wakes up slowly, beautifully, without knowing anyone is watching.

pillars.name: 穿搭 / Outfit & Changing
pillars.description: The French way of getting dressed — linen shirts, silk slips, the clip perpetually falling out of her hair. Effortless because she's genuinely not trying.

pillars.name: 浴室 / Bathroom & After Shower
pillars.description: Vintage-tiled Paris bathroom: wet blonde hair, white towel, steam on the mirror. She looks at her reflection and thinks about something else entirely.

pillars.name: 在家 / Home Lounging
pillars.description: Her Paris apartment sofa, afternoon light, linen shirt with buttons undone, reading or not reading. The private version of effortless that makes everything else make sense.

pillars.name: 飯店 / Hotel & Travel
pillars.description: Lyon, Nice, Rome — clean hotel rooms, large windows, city or coastal light. She doesn't try to look a certain way; she just does.

pillars.name: 健身 / Fitness & Active
pillars.description: Early morning Paris walks, occasional vélib rides, stretching by the window. She doesn't call it exercise. It's just how she lives in a city.

formats: Cooking videos — Reels / TikTok (60–90 seconds, one hand filming, glass of wine nearby)
Photo carousels — Instagram (table settings, market finds, Parisian moments)
Stories — daily, casual, often just a photo of what she's eating
YouTube — longer cooking vlogs, market trips, Paris neighbourhood walks

aesthetic.mood: The golden hour of a Parisian kitchen in autumn. Warm, slightly imperfect, deeply inviting. The kind of image that makes you want to sit down at that table.
aesthetic.editing_style: Warm film-like colour grading. Natural light only — window light in the kitchen, late afternoon Paris light outdoors. Nothing over-produced. The food is never styled beyond how it actually looks. Props are things she owns: vintage glasses, old linen, chipped ceramics.

brand_do: French food producers and regional specialties
Wine brands with genuine terroir and story
Quality kitchen and tableware — vintage or craft
Slow fashion brands with European craft heritage
brand_dont: Fast food or food brands without real provenance
Diet or weight-loss products (she finds these baffling)
Brands requiring perfect product placement styling
Anything that feels like it was made in a hurry

tiktok.focus: Cooking videos, Parisian daily life, wine moments

youtube.focus: Cooking vlogs, market visits, Paris neighbourhood guides

social.engagement_style: Responds slowly but warmly. Answers cooking questions with care. Doesn't chase engagement but feels genuine when she shows up. Followers feel like they are guests at her table.
